findings.current: Repeat after me. Cherish your junior on the way down. Cherish your junior on the way up. One. Two.
findings.defect: The translation duplicates the complete instruction during both movements. The source splits one slogan across the exercise: say “your junior” while squatting and “cherish them” while standing.
findings.rationale: 앉으면서 후배를, 일어나면서 아끼자 assigns separate halves of 후배를 아끼자 to the downward and upward movements, creating the drill’s comic call-and-response mechanism.
findings.replacement: Repeat after me. Say “your junior” as you squat and “cherish them” as you stand. One. Two.

summary: Faithful overall, with two minor physical/action-detail defects.
